label: Art movement
description: Named art movements, historical schools, regional painting traditions, and graphic or internet aesthetics.
notes: Named movements, schools, visual traditions, and recognizable design aesthetics belong here; art.artist holds individual creators, art.medium holds materials, and art.style holds broader rendering styles. Values are short names that follow “in the style of,” with visual differences explained in look. Period is a local browsing group for origins or strongest association, not a restriction on the era of the depicted scene; non_western_traditions groups traditions that span several dates. Orientalist painting names the historical European genre and Aboriginal dot painting names the recognizable dot-based tradition rather than all Aboriginal art. Primitivism is the historical modernist label, not a label for the traditions it borrowed from.
